#summary EchoTest example.

= !EchoTest Example. =

This example uses [http://code.google.com/p/red5/ Red5 project]'s echo test application.

The contact manager example has scripts for serving the application via CherryPy, Twisted Web, or WSGI.

Start the server and point your browser to the domain:port the server is running on.
CherryPy

Use CherryPy web framework to serve the example contact manager over http with the following command:

python echo_test/python/cp_server.py

Twisted Example

Use Twisted web framework to serve the example contact manager over http with the following command:

twistd -noy echo_test/python/cp_server.py

WSGI Example

Use simple WSGI to serve the example contact manager over http with the following command:

python echo_test/python/wsgi_server.py

The WSGI example does not serve the Flash file, so you will have to manually open the file in your browser:

echo_test/flex/deploy/red5Test.html

The WSGI example also does not server the crossdomain.xml file, so this example will only work locally.
